management_notes: Churchill's management team is executing a credible multi-property land assembly in NL's antimony-gold belt — TSXV approval of the Golden Baie option (Canstar Resources deal) adds a third project alongside Frost Cove and Black Raven, and the team has maintained continuous drill-result flow into 2026. The data-correction incident (May 2026 restated Frost Cove results) remains a credibility overhang that has not been neutralised by clean, independently audited output. Insider ownership is not documented in available public filings; the April 2026 interim MD&A (source of extracted cap-table data) does not provide a management/insider ownership breakdown accessible through public disclosure search. The 316.7M shares outstanding is consistent with a history of serial dilutive financings, suggesting management has historically prioritised treasury over per-share value. Score held at 2 pending (a) evidence of insider ownership >5% of outstanding, or (b) a clean NI 43-101 resource that rehabilitates the prior correction.
geology_notes: High-grade antimony mineralisation is confirmed across multiple programs. The 2025 maiden drill program at Black Raven/southern Frost Cove returned best intervals of 7.25% Sb over 1.98m, 6.44% Sb over 2.06m, 4.84% Sb over 1.00m, and 3.94% Sb over 1.60m — all confirmed via independent news aggregators. A secondary gold-silver system at depth returned 5.89 g/t AuEq over 1.00m, adding polymetallic optionality. The district footprint now spans at least four areas: Frost Cove North, Frost Cove South/Black Raven, Beaver Brook, and Golden Baie (optioned). Golden Baie's 2026 program — systematic trenching, channel sampling, drilling, and airborne geophysics — represents a fresh geological vector in central NL's antimony belt. The technical report on file is an NI 43-101 dated 2023-08-01; no mineral resource estimate has been declared. All resource fields remain null. Score of 3 reflects genuinely exceptional antimony grades with a developing district thesis, constrained by the absence of a compliant resource and the prior data-correction incident.
capital_notes: Capital structure is the principal risk for new investors. Shares issued outstanding: 316,681,940; shares fully diluted: 342,756,940 — sourced from the April 29, 2026 interim MD&A (extracted JSON, sha256 f48119422ed45e5221bbb4bc336ee2176965c42d73986bf3a72af32ac4435736). The warrant overhang is contained at 2,625,000 (strike and expiry not captured in MD&A summary table). The option pool of 23,450,000 represents approximately 7.4% of issued shares — material but consistent with sector norms for a company of this stage. No flow-through share tranches were identified in the April 2026 filing; extraction notes explicitly confirm no FT placements were detected in that period. The fundamental problem is scale: at 316.7M basic shares, generating meaningful per-share value requires a resource declaration large enough to support a multi-hundred-million-dollar NAV. Golden Baie exploration and northern Frost Cove assays do not change this arithmetic in the near term. Score of 2 is warranted.
catalyst_notes: Multiple near-term catalysts across the 2026 program. Nine northern Frost Cove holes were awaiting assay as of the most recent corporate progress update; these results represent the immediate binary event. The 2026 Golden Baie program (just received TSXV approval) includes airborne geophysics, systematic trenching/channel sampling, and a drill campaign — this is a multi-quarter catalyst pipeline. The macro environment remains supportive: China antimony export restrictions (in force since late 2024) continue to sustain elevated Sb pricing and strategic demand from Western governments and battery/semiconductor industries. A maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate — no timeline disclosed publicly — would be the step-change re-rating catalyst. Score of 3 reflects a live, near-term news flow but no single confirmed imminent catalyst.
acquisition_notes: No formal resource precludes quantitative P/NAV analysis; nav_per_share is null. The qualitative acquisition case is strengthened by the combination of: (a) confirmed high-grade antimony intercepts in an underexplored Canadian jurisdiction; (b) a consolidating land position across multiple antimony occurrences in NL; (c) China's antimony export ban creating structural demand for Western supply; and (d) the small size of the North American antimony exploration peer set. The discovery of a gold-silver system at Black Raven adds multi-commodity appeal. Comparable transactions — Perpetua Resources (Kinross deal, Idaho antimony-gold project), various EU critical-mineral M&A — suggest strategic acquirers will pay premiums beyond conventional NAV multiples for assured supply. Score of 3 reflects strong strategic optionality constrained by the absence of a declared resource to anchor transaction valuation.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources (CRI.V) holds its WATCH rating into the June 16, 2026 scorecard cycle. The fundamental story is unchanged: Churchill is assembling a district-scale antimony-gold land position in Newfoundland (Frost Cove North/South, Black Raven, Beaver Brook, Golden Baie) at a time when antimony's critical-mineral status — driven by China's export restrictions — is at its highest ever. Drill results from 2025-2026 confirm genuine high-grade mineralisation (7.25% Sb/1.98m, 6.44% Sb/2.06m) with a secondary gold-silver system discovered at Black Raven. The Golden Baie option received TSXV approval and a 2026 exploration program including airborne geophysics and drilling is planned. Near-term catalysts: northern Frost Cove 2026 assays (nine holes pending), Golden Baie 2026 program initiation, and any maiden resource timeline announcement. The two overriding constraints remain the heavy share structure (316.7M basic, 342.8M fully diluted) and the May 2026 data-correction incident.
